exposure: Tidal volume (VT) delivery during positive pressure ventilation (PPV) at birth
cohort: The study included 165 preterm infants less than 29 weeks' gestation who received positive pressure ventilation in the delivery room.
finding: High tidal volume delivery during mask positive pressure ventilation at birth was associated with a significantly higher incidence of brain injury, including IVH and severe IVH, in preterm infants.
followup_time: Within the first days after birth
birth_weight: 858 (251) g in high VT group, 915 (250) g in normal VT group
gest_age: 26 (2) weeks in high VT group, 26 (1) weeks in normal VT group
